name: search_files
description:
Search file contents or find files by name. Use this instead of grep/rg/find/ls in terminal. Respects .gitignore and skips hidden and binary files.

Content search (target='content'): Regex search inside files. Output modes: full matches with line numbers, file paths only, or match counts. With group_by_file the matches come back grouped per file (one text per file, matched lines as N:text and context lines as N-text), which is shorter when many matches share files.

File search (target='files'): Find files by glob pattern (e.g., '*.py', '*config*'). Also use this instead of ls. Discovery order is the fast default; 'modified' sorts newest-first and may scan the full tree.

pattern.description: Regex pattern for content search, or glob pattern (e.g., '*.py') for file search

target.description: 'content' searches inside file contents, 'files' searches for files by name

path.description: Directory or file to search in (default: current working directory)

file_glob.description: Filter files by pattern in grep mode (e.g., '*.py' to only search Python files)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50)

offset.description: Skip first N results for pagination (default: 0)

order.description: File-search order: 'discovery' is fast traversal order; 'modified' is newest-first and may scan the full tree; ignored for content

output_mode.description: Output format for grep mode: 'content' shows matching lines with line numbers, 'files_only' lists file paths, 'count' shows match counts per file

context.description: Number of context lines before and after each match (grep mode only)

group_by_file.description: Content search with output_mode=content: group the matches per file, with overlapping context merged (default false: one entry per match).
